newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sing Tao rises after trade resumes.
newsitem.headline: Sing Tao rises after trade resumes.

text.p: Shares of Sing Tao Holdings Ltd were steady on Wednesday when trading in the stock resumed after the newspaper publisher and printer's decision to close its evening newspaper, the Sing Tao Evening Post.
Sing Tao shares touched an early high of HK$3.70, up HK$0.175 or nearly five percent soon after trading resumed.
Turnover was thin at 670,000 shares worth HK$2.42 million in the first hour.
"The group said closing down the loss-making evening newspaper would save around HK$50 million a year, and that is definitely good news," said Stanley Ng, research manager of Mansion House.
But Ng also said since the company posted heavy losses last fiscal year, investors should remain cautious until they saw any concrete recovery on earnings.
